[ cf S. prakṣepa], being thrown into, incarceration; being placed in, inclusion; ascription; Nidd I 268, 27 (°-bandhanena vā baddho, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se omit; Nidd-a I 354, 33 : bandhanāgārikabandhanena vā baddho, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be nāgarikabandhena baddho) ≠ 403, 2 ( Be, Ce so; Ee, Se pekkha-); Ps I 244, 17 (kāye abhūtānaṃ subhasukhabhāvādīnaṃ ~assa … pahānaṃ); II 218, 6 (samodhānaṃ gacchantī ti odhānaṃ ~aṃ gacchanti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se upakkhepaṃ; = Spk III 134, 2 : eds upakkhepaṃ) = Mp III 384, 19 ( Ce, Ee so; Be, Se upanikkhepaṃ) = V 4, 24 ; Spk I 44, 30 (maccuno yogaṃ payogaṃ ~aṃ upakkhepaṃ … āgacchanti); Pv-a 221, 14 (mahāniraye ~o ti); — ifc see samidhā-.
